lines.zh: 我每落一次就摊开一圈。
lines.en: Each landing spreads me in a ring.
On landing my body spreads flat.
I leap up and come down.

lines.zh: 黄色的胶体在阳光下透亮
lines.en: Yellow gel glows in the sun.

lines.zh: 我每跳一次就往前一段
lines.en: Each hop carries me a stretch.
I bounce and bend the grass.
My surface quivers.
I do not jump high, but often.
Wet round marks stay behind.

lines.zh: 我滚过一块石头，被弹起来
lines.en: I roll over a stone and am thrown up.
I stop and slowly slump.

lines.zh: 我的影子是个晃动的圆
lines.en: My shadow is a wobbling circle.
I slide a little way along the ground.

lines.zh: 我朝着有动静的地方跳
lines.en: I hop toward the movement.

lines.zh: 我跳的时候发出黏腻的响
lines.en: My hops make a sticky sound.
My edge is rather thin.
I lie spread out, quite still.
I warm slowly in the sun.
There is a small core inside me.

lines.zh: 我吸了一点土，又吐出来
lines.en: I take in a bit of soil and let it out.
Leaves show in my surface.
I lie in the grass, soaking up sun.
My shape is not very round now.
An insect bumps into me.
I draw my edges back in.
I have no lungs to breathe with.
In the grass my color stands out.
I shake and droplets fly off.
I spread out toward you.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但我看得见
lines.en: I have no eyes, but I see.

lines.zh: 你脚边那块黄的就是我。
lines.en: That yellow at your feet is me.
I rise a little, then slump.
You stand still; so do I.
My color darkens in the shade.
You stepped on my edge.
I roll once toward you.
I swell once toward you.

lines.zh: 我没有表情可以给你看
lines.en: I have no face to show you.
I am beaten flat.
I swell back a little.
I wobble and cannot hold.
A piece is sheared off.
I hop back twice.
It hurts, and I cannot say so.
My core is still here.
I slowly round out again.
Not another one.
A corner scattered; it fills back in.
Those things are sunk in the soil.
I cannot absorb that.
You set it too far from me.
I wrapped it a while; it will not dissolve.
I have wrapped it up.
It is dissolving slowly.
This is not enough to fill.
This much only wets me.
You may walk away now.
I eat very slowly.
I hit you and bounce back.
Your sole sinks into me.
Then it swells back.
You step down and I slide out.
A patch of yellow stays on the ground.
I have no bones; I cannot hurt you.
I cling to your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞散了半边
lines.en: That scattered half of me.
I gather myself back.
The foot you stamped with slid away.

lines.zh: 你滑了一下，是我在脚下
lines.en: You slipped; that was me underfoot.
I have wet your sole.

lines.zh: 我贴着靴子跟你走了两步
lines.en: I cling to your boot for two steps.
The force of your step scatters.
Our kind merge.
Two collide and become larger.
I am not particular; anyone will do.
This meadow is enough to share.
We have no sexes.
Being bigger is a little safer.
There is a sound when we meet.
We slowly merge into one.
I do not fight; I wait.
We merge, then part.
I wrap the thing inside me.
It dissolves slowly.
Too small; I cannot keep it.
It slides out of me.
I lift it, then take it in.
The weight distorts me.
It rolled halfway under me.
It is not for eating; I do not want it.
It is stuck at my edge.
It went in and slid back out.

lines.zh: 我的边已经碰到你的鞋。
lines.en: My edge is already touching your shoe.
I hop toward you.
I have no other way.
Touching you is enough.
I bounce quite high.
You back off; I bounce over.
My body scatters on impact.
But I bounce back.
I have your direction.

lines.zh: 我弹起来，冲着你的膝盖。
lines.en: I bounce, aimed at your knee.
I approach one hop at a time.
Each time you give a little ground.
I do not tire.
My landings sound sticky.
My marks are on the grass.
You circle the tree; I hop straight.
My edge keeps pointing at you.
Further back is the water.
I wait for you to step in.

lines.zh: 黄澄澄的我正对准你蹦来。
lines.en: Yellow as I am, I bounce straight at you.
I slam into you bodily.
Where I touch, it hurts.
That scattered a bit of me.

lines.zh: 撞散之后我又拢成一团。
lines.en: After the impact I gather back into a blob.
I come down on you.
You were stuck for a moment.
Light, but very sticky.
My color is on you.
I bounce far away.
I start hopping again.
I swell up out of the grass.

lines.zh: 黄色的身体在光下发亮
lines.en: My yellow body shines in the light.
First I sink and spread out.
Another of me is nearby.
One hop and I have advanced.
Soil sticks to me.
I slowly round my edge.
A wet mark appears on the meadow.
I do not know where I came from.
The weather suits me.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身体开始冒泡
lines.en: Fire makes my body bubble.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，摊成一片
lines.en: I fall from above and spread flat.
In water half of me dissolves.
The blast throws me into several blobs.

lines.zh: 东西穿过去，留下一个孔
lines.en: Something passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的核心发烫
lines.en: That force heats my core.
I have shrunk a little.
Current runs wild inside me.
There is nothing here to cling to.
